```{r}
library(pacman)
```

```{r}
total <- read_csv('../data/total.csv')
total
```

```{r}


total_sum <- total %>%
  transmute(
    `Annual Visitation` = Year_vis,
    `Total Spending` = tot_spend_adj,
    `Jobs` = jobs,
    `Labor Income` = labor_inc_adj,
    `Value Added` = val_add_adj,
    `Economic Output` = econ_output_adj
  )

table_gt <- datasummary(
  `Annual Visitation` +
    `Total Spending` +
    `Jobs` +
    `Labor Income` +
    `Value Added` +
    `Economic Output` ~
    N + Mean + SD + Min + Median + Max,
  data = total_sum,
  fmt = 2,
  notes = "Note: All dollar values are reported in thousands of 2024 dollars ($000s) and have been adjusted for inflation using the annual-average CPI-U.",
  output = "gt"
)

```


```{r}

table_gt
```

```{r}
## CREATING TREATMENT TIME

total_annual <- total[, -c(2:13)] # annual data only
#write.csv(total_annual, "../data/total_yr.csv", row.names = FALSE)
 
did_data <- total_annual %>%
  filter(is.na(start_year) | start_year >= 2012) %>% #removing parks that were treated before 2012 
  mutate(
    cohort = if_else(
      !is.na(start_year) & start_year <= max(Year),
      as.integer(start_year),
      Inf
      ),
      
    treated = as.integer(
      is.finite(cohort) & Year >= cohort
      ),
    
    log_vis = log(Year_vis),
    Year_vis = na_if(Year_vis, 0),
    log_spend = log(tot_spend_adj),
    log_labor_inc = log(labor_inc_adj),
    log_val = log(val_add_adj),
    log_econ = log(econ_output_adj)

  )


```

```{r}
#SUNAB LOG VISITATION

m1 <- feols(
  log_vis ~ sunab(cohort, Year, ref.p = -1) |
    Park + Year,
  data = did_data,
  cluster = ~Park
)

summary(m1)
iplot(m1)

# SUNAB TOT SPEND
m2 <- feols(
  log_spend ~ sunab(cohort, Year, ref.p = -1) |
    Park + Year,
  data = did_data,
  cluster = ~Park
)

summary(m2)
iplot(m2)

# SUNAB TOT SPEND
m3 <- feols(
  log_spend ~ sunab(cohort, Year, ref.p = -1) |
    Park + Year,
  data = did_data,
  cluster = ~Park
)

summary(m3)
iplot(m3)
```

```{r}

vars = c("log_vis", "log_spend", "log_labor_inc", "log_val", "log_econ")

models <- setNames(
  lapply(vars, function(outcome) {

    formula <- as.formula(
      paste0(
        outcome,
        " ~ sunab(cohort, Year, ref.p = -1) | Park + Year"
      )
    )

    feols(
      formula,
      data = did_data,
      cluster = ~Park
    )
  }),
  vars
)

etable(
  models,
  agg = "period"
)

iplot(
  models,
  xlab = "Years relative to adoption",
  ylab = "Estimated effect",
  sep = 0.5
)
```

```{r}
model_no2020 <- feols(
  log_vis ~ sunab(cohort, Year, ref.p = -1) |
    Park + Year,
  data = did_data %>%
    filter(Year != 2020),
  cluster = ~Park
)

iplot(model_no2020)

```

```{r}

library(dplyr)

did_data %>%
  distinct(Park, cohort) %>%
  mutate(
    cohort_group = if_else(
      is.infinite(cohort),
      "Never treated",
      as.character(cohort)
    )
  ) %>%
  count(cohort_group, name = "number_of_parks")

```
